# Startup readback: AI-27

Contract version: 1

## Objective and acceptance outcomes

Harden the existing personal Google connection (`personal_data_source` for `matthewirving99@gmail.com`) so source selection is explicit, sync stays within selected resources, and revocation/reconnection is observable and recoverable.

1. A user can select Drive files through Google Picker, and discovery/sync fetches metadata only for persisted selected file IDs. No account-wide Drive listing or unselected file metadata is returned or stored.
2. Changing selection is atomic: deselected Drive rows become unselected while their historical rows/provenance remain; retained selections continue incremental sync without duplicate application.
3. The existing connection lifecycle remains least-privilege and supports the issue’s staging sequence: connect, select and sync one dedicated file, update it once, revoke selection/consent, observe no further import, reconnect and recover with freshness/error state.

## Dependencies and relevant contracts

- Linear AI-12 supplies authenticated endpoints; AI-19 supplies freshness, trace/audit correlation, and provenance; AI-64 moved the selected Drive-file access and processing proof to this issue. The current issue adds exact role/account and Google Tasks date-only constraints.
- Build Spec §§26.1–26.5 governs OAuth scopes and Google Calendar/Drive integration. Agent Spec §§12.1, 12.5, 12.7, 25.6, 29, and 34 govern Planner context, Gmail communication, source boundaries, and manager evidence. Frontend Constitution §13.5 governs source freshness/confidence presentation. `docs/adr/0008-source-permission-evidence.md` and `docs/onboarding/google-account-topology.md` define source permission evidence and account topology.
- Existing seams: `google-connection-sources`, `public.update_google_source_selection`, `google_drive_files.selected`, and the Drive `drive.file` cursor. Preserve existing authenticated/AAL2/MFA checks and token storage. `google-connection-sources` may return only public Picker configuration; the browser obtains a short-lived GIS token for only `drive.file` with `include_granted_scopes=false`. Never return the backend refresh token or combined access token to the browser. Staging also needs `GOOGLE_PICKER_API_KEY` and `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_NUMBER` with restricted origins; absent config is a staging readiness gate.
- Using existing `google-connection-sources`, `public.update_google_source_selection`, and `google_drive_files` contracts; integration risks: DB-03, DB-05, DB-11, GOOGLE-01, WEB-01, and ACC-02.
- Relevant integration rules: DB-03/DB-05, DB-11, GOOGLE-01, WEB-01, ACC-02, and QA-01. Confirmed integration defects were account-wide Drive metadata discovery, deselection leaving stored rows marked selected, strict CSP omitting the Picker's required origins, and Windows shell argument splitting in the local QA runner; each has a focused regression and an evidence-linked rule/ledger entry.

## Implementation and boundaries

- Add Picker-backed explicit Drive file selection using the existing authenticated connection and persisted selected IDs. Filter provider change events before fetching per-file metadata. In the forward migration redefine the existing source-selection RPC so selection configuration and row selected-state updates are atomic and historical provenance is retained.
- Keep Calendar read/write, Tasks read/write with date-only due values, and Gmail command mailbox semantics in their existing boundaries. Do not broaden OAuth scopes, import all Drive/mail, change account identities, rewrite MFA, add Apple write-back, or take on AI-30 Planner writes / AI-24 Gmail command ingestion.
- One owner remains accountable through merge. No subagents or delegated implementation. Shared DB reset/test and browser/staging verification are serialized with the root and other issue owners; do not overlap their leases.

## Hosted proof and readiness

- Required live-only proof is the issue’s staging Google connect → explicit selected-file sync → provider update applied once → selection revoke and consent/token revoke → reconnect/recovery flow, including proof that an unrelated Drive resource was not fetched/stored and source freshness/error state is truthful.
- The ticket-owned runner is `corepack pnpm test:e2e:live:google-oauth-acceptance`. It requires exact deployed candidate SHA/tree/PR/deployment run, `LIVE_E2E_MANUAL_MFA=true`, staging Supabase connection settings, and dedicated synthetic selected/unselected Drive fixtures. It opens a headed Chromium journey, emits no evidence until all account/scope, Picker, selected-only sync/idempotency, provider update, deselection/revoke, OAuth revoke/reconnect, and freshness assertions pass, and hashes provider resource IDs in the strict artifact.
- Staging readiness is still externally blocked: the Google Picker API key and Cloud project number are not confirmed, OAuth client configuration/authorization is not verified, and dedicated synthetic Drive fixtures are not confirmed. The Google staging runner and provider mutation have not been run.
- Keep login/MFA operator-owned. When the dedicated headed browser is ready, pause and ask the user to complete/confirm the sign-in or fresh MFA step. Do not mark Done before the required live sign-off and downstream exact-candidate profile acceptance.
